codeReview.summary: Reviewed the fix commit against all four prior failed fix reviews and found that it closes each of the five remaining round-2 blockers. OAuth regression coverage was restored by making the auth stub persist credentials and by asserting both stored GitHub credentials and `/api/v1/git/providers` connected=true in the callback round-trip test. Repo import now validates `parsedURL.Hostname()` against the `github.com` / `*.github.com` boundary and adds lookalike-domain coverage. Python component builds now pass a module name instead of a `.py` filename to `componentize-py`, uploaded-artifact BuildJobs now carry `buildStrategy=prebuilt_wasm` on the returned struct, and the deployment suite now includes a create→poll lifecycle test that verifies `runtimeEndpoint` and `status=running` from the operation result. I did not find any remaining or newly introduced blocking issues in scope for this rerun.
